rule.name: NewlineOnlyLineSplit
rule.message: This splits text read from a file on "\n" only, so every line of a CRLF file keeps a trailing carriage return, comparisons and regular expressions are off, and text that uses a lone carriage return is not split at all. Split on every line terminator with split("\\R") or lines(), or read it line by line with a BufferedReader. Text the program generated itself is fine.
